mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS sample_count, AVG(CAST(e.amount AS DOUBLE) / t.original_price) AS avg_ratio FROM escrow e JOIN listing l ON l.id = e.listing_id JOIN ticket t ON t.id = l.ticket_id WHERE e.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND e.confirmed_at >= #{since} AND t.category = #{category} AND t.original_price > 0

SELECT t.category AS category, COUNT(*) AS ticket_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'TRANSFERRED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS traded_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'EXPIRED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expired_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.id IS NOT NULL THEN e.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS traded_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 'EXPIRED' THEN t.original_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lost_amount, AVG(CASE WHEN e.id IS NOT NULL AND t.original_price > 0 THEN CAST(e.amount AS DOUBLE) / t.original_price END) AS avg_ratio FROM ticket t LEFT JOIN listing l ON l.ticket_id = t.id AND l.status = 'COMPLETED' LEFT JOIN escrow e ON e.listing_id = l.id AND e.status = 'CONFIRMED' GROUP BY t.category ORDER BY t.category

SELECT CAST(t.expires_at AS DATE) AS loss_date, COUNT(*) AS expired_count, COUNT(l.id) AS listed_count, COALESCE(SUM(t.original_price), 0) AS original_loss, COALESCE(SUM(l.asking_price), 0) AS market_loss FROM ticket t LEFT JOIN listing l ON l.ticket_id = t.id AND l.status = 'EXPIRED' WHERE t.status = 'EXPIRED' AND t.expires_at >= #{since} GROUP BY CAST(t.expires_at AS DATE) ORDER BY loss_date
